# Changelog

All notable changes to this plugin will be documented here.

## 1.0.0 — initial release

- Added the `lannis` MCP server pointing at Lannis's hosted endpoint (`https://mcp.lannis.app/mcp`).
- Auth uses OAuth with Lannis user sign-in.
- Logo: references the publisher-submitted URL (`https://lannis.app/icon-512.png`); the file could not be downloaded when this plugin was added.
